text:
Lina: Huge round of applause to @MarcoT, @PriyaR, and the oncall rotation for rescuing the inference cluster last night — fixed the cache-stomp bug and restored Dedicated capacity by 2am. Coffee and donuts (virtual) to all :clap: :coffee:
Marco T.: ugh my keyboard remembers that midnight deploy. Happy to help — team telemetries saved us. Shout to Alex G. for the quick rollback plan.
Alex G.: glad the rollback play worked. Also thumbs up to @SRE-bot for the alerting graph that pinpointed the KV eviction patterns.
Priya R.: team effort! I pushed a hotfix to kv-cache with a quick test. Will open a proper PR tomorrow with perf regression checks.
DevOps-bot: Incident #2026-0412 - cluster degraded -> recovered. Timeline and logs: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-0412
Lina: Noted — Priya, when you open the PR can you tag eng-runtime and eng-sre? we'll schedule a small postmortem next week.
Marco T.: will do. Also whoever ordered the emergency donuts owes me one IRL :stuck_out_tongue: 
Alex G.: I nominate a "late-night-rescue" badge in Donut Club. :medal:
Sasha: Agree — small shout to ops and design folks who jumped in. Great teamwork.
Lina: Thanks all. Leaving this thread pinned for the postmortem notes. :heart:
